title: FITNESS ASSESSMENT AND EXERCISE PRESCRIPTION
description: Introduction to physical fitness assessments and the skills needed to design safe and effective exercise programs for apparently healthy adults.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: KIN 324.
A minimum grade of C- is required in KIN 324.
